verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Terraform has a workspace concept: state is tied to "your workspace's state" and HCP Terraform has workspaces with their own policy enforcement UI. Configurations are also reusable through modules and can store state in remote backends, which hints at per-environment separation. However, no evidence describes using workspaces or stacks to separate dev, staging and prod, so support is only implied. Missing for 10: documented per-environment workspace/stack management (e.g. workspace create/select commands), per-environment variable/config handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration of environment separation.
